revenue.source: Eni ESEF annual reports (accessions BUCRF72VH5RBN7X3VL35-2025-12-31-ESEF-IT-0 / 2024-12-31), ifrs-full:RevenueFromContractsWithCustomers, EUR millions

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: revenue fell 5.2% in FY2025 and 5.3% in FY2024 on lower energy prices; I assume a further small decline in FY2026, then a recovery to about 2% (inflation-like). Not a filed figure.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2023-25 margins were 8.8%, 5.9% and 6.1% (filed EBIT / revenue). I use 6.5%, slightly above the FY2024-25 level and below the FY2023 peak, as a mid-cycle value.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: Eni's oil and gas profits are taxed at high rates. The filed FY2025 tax rate would be pretax 5,778 less net income, but net income is attributable to owners only, so I could not derive it. I use 40% as a conservative placeholder for the reviewer to check.

da_pct_revenue.source: FY2023-25 D&A / revenue was 8.0%, 8.6% and 8.9% (filed). I use 9.0%, in line with the latest year.

capex_pct_revenue.source: FY2023-25 capex / revenue was 9.3%, 9.0% and 10.6% (filed). I use 10% as the three-year average, slightly above D&A.

wacc.source: Assumption. Inputs: 10Y EUR AAA yield 3.266% (ECB, 2026-11-05); Italy ERP 6.69% (Damodaran, 2026-02-16); beta of about 1.0 is assumed because I did not pull an industry beta, so cost of equity is about 9.96%. Pre-tax cost of debt is about 5%. I assume a debt weight of about 35%, which gives a WACC near 8%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below the 10Y EUR risk-free rate of 3.27% and below long-run euro nominal GDP growth, which suits an energy company facing a transition.

net_debt.source: Eni ESEF FY2025 (BUCRF72VH5RBN7X3VL35-2025-12-31-ESEF-IT-0), derived: total debt 28,502 (LT borrowings 20,139 + ST 4,929 + current portion 3,434) less cash 8,100; no short-term investments reported; EUR millions

diluted_shares.source: Not reported as a tagged value. Derived as net income attributable to owners 2,608 / diluted EPS 0.78 (both FY2025 ESEF), about 3,344 million shares. The EPS is rounded, so this is approximate; the reviewer should check it against the filing.
